title: Untitled (Collaboration with Giulio Rosk)
altText: Stunning street art mural in Wynwood, Miami by Mr Blob and Giulio Rosk, featuring two hyperrealistic portraits facing a central surreal biomechanical character connected by glowing lines.
description: A second Wynwood collaboration with Giulio Rosk, painted on a private wall in Miami in 2021. Two hyperrealistic portraits face each other across the composition, their fingers pulling glowing golden threads tied to a surreal biomechanical creature at the center — realism and pop surrealism literally strung together in one image.
